text: Academic Standing: A student must maintain a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 2.00 to remain in good standing. Failure to do so leads to academic probation.
Library Services: The university library opens at 8:00 AM and closes at 10:00 PM on weekdays. Valid student ID card is mandatory for entry.
Campus Recreation: The university gymnasium and sports fields are open for all registered undergraduate students during scheduled athletic hours.
